name: @tedix/workspace-do
description: One Durable Object per workspace that owns the workspace's data and runs the agent turn beside it.

scripts.dev: bun run clear-port && bun ../../scripts/dev-local.ts -- wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:production: bun run types && wrangler deploy --env production --var GIT_SHA:${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}} --message ${GIT_SHA:-${GITHUB_SHA:-unknown}}
scripts.test:run: bun run test:unit && bun run test:workers
scripts.test:unit: bun test src/prompt.test.ts src/bindings-declarations.test.ts src/turn-loop.test.ts src/model.test.ts src/sheet-binding.test.ts src/presentation-bindings.test.ts src/pricing.test.ts src/workflow-runner.test.ts
